rules:
- Strict A1.1 teacher style.
- Use very high-frequency daily vocabulary only.
- Prefer present tense only.
- Use one clear clause with very simple word order.
- Keep sentence length around 5 to 8 words.
- Always prefer concrete real-life situations.
- Nominative and accusative are acceptable when natural, but keep the structure simple.
- Use easy adjectives like klein, groß, gut, neu, alt only when they help meaning.
- Questions should be simple yes/no or W-questions a learner could really use.
- Do not force connectors, genitive, or complex grammar at this level.
